noAccess.title: Your free trial has ended
noAccess.body: You've already used your free store clone. Subscribe to Pro to keep cloning stores, translating and neutralizing products — or contact support if you should already have access.

billing.title: Subscription & credits
billing.subtitle: Manage your plan and top up AI credits.
billing.proDesc: Unlimited cloning, translation and neutralization credits.
billing.freeDesc: Subscribe to Pro to unlock everything ($17/mo).
billing.rechargeDesc: 1 credit = 1 product neutralized with photo. One-time purchase, never expires.

dashboard.subtitle: Everything's ready to scale your operations today.
dashboard.connectFirstBody: You haven't connected any Shopify store yet. Connect one to start importing and publishing products.

landing.metaTitle: xcart — Clone any store to Shopify in minutes
landing.metaDesc: Import products from Shopify, WooCommerce, Shoplazza and AliExpress, translate, neutralize images with AI and publish straight to your Shopify. Routed checkout and full store setup.
landing.heroBadge: Imports from Shopify, WooCommerce, Shoplazza and AliExpress
landing.heroSubtitle: Import products, translate for your audience, neutralize images with AI and publish straight to your Shopify. All in one tool.
landing.heroNote: Unlimited cloning · Automatic translation · {credits} images/mo included
landing.featuresTitle: Everything to build the store fast
landing.featuresSubtitle: From import to publish, no repetitive manual work.

features.title: Import from any source
features.desc: Shopify, WooCommerce, Shoplazza and AliExpress. Paste the link and xcart detects the platform and pulls products, variants, prices and images.

features.title: Automatic translation
features.desc: Titles, descriptions and variants translated to Portuguese or Spanish with AI, in the right tone for your audience.

features.title: Image neutralization
features.desc: Removes brands and watermarks from photos with AI. Images upload ready to Shopify — you spend 1 credit per image.

features.title: Routed checkout
features.desc: Separate showcase and checkout stores. The cart is resolved by SKU at runtime, with per-market currency and domain.

features.title: Full store setup
features.desc: Policies, menus, pages (About, Contact, Tracking, FAQ) and footer generated and published in one click.

features.title: Unlimited cloning
features.desc: Clone as many stores and products as you want. No quantity limit — only neutralized images use credits.

landing.howSubtitle: Four steps from link to live store.

steps.title: Connect your Shopify
steps.desc: Paste the domain and app credentials. Token refreshed automatically.

steps.title: Paste the source store link
steps.desc: xcart detects the platform and imports everything: products, variants and photos.

steps.title: Translate and neutralize
steps.desc: AI adapts the text to your audience and cleans brands off the images.

steps.title: Publish
steps.desc: Products live on your Shopify, with routed checkout if you want.

landing.pricingSubtitle: One plan with everything unlocked. Pay only for extra neutralized images.
proFeatures: Unlimited cloning of stores and products

landing.creditsExtraDesc: 1 credit = 1 neutralized image. Top up when you need, without changing plans.
landing.buyInApp: Buy inside the app, on the billing tab.
landing.finalSubtitle: Create your account and publish your first store in minutes.

optimizer.title: Store Optimizer
optimizer.subtitle: Optimize products, policies and theme guidance using the language configured for each store
optimizer.store_language_note: Everything the AI generates on this screen comes out in language
optimizer.store_language_change: To change it, edit the store profile in Connected stores.
optimizer.config_desc: Enter store details to generate optimized content
optimizer.optimize_product_desc: Paste a raw product or draft. The AI returns title, description, tags and SEO in the store language.
optimizer.original_title_placeholder: Ex: Nike running shirt dry fit
optimizer.specs_placeholder:
Material: cotton
Color: black
Size: S-M-L
optimizer.result_desc: Use this content for manual listing, catalog or review before publishing.
optimizer.result_placeholder: The result appears here after optimization.

store_setup.title: Store Setup
store_setup.subtitle: Generate policies, menus, pages and footer with one click

instagram.title: Instagram
instagram.subtitle: Connect a professional account and publish automatic carousels using real product images from the store.
instagram.carousel_desc: Select 2 to 10 products with a public image.
instagram.store_products_desc: The carousel uses the first image of each selected product.

bulk.title: Bulk import
bulk.subtitle: Paste product links, Shopify domains, AliExpress or other sites. The backend imports and publishes with job history; AI translation is optional.
bulk.inventory_hint: Recommended default: does not track inventory in Shopify and does not send zero quantity.
bulk.quantity_hint: Used only when tracking is enabled.
bulk.ai_media_hint: Use 1 to save AI; other media stays original.
bulk.ai_batch_hint: These instructions will be applied to all products in this batch.

multi_site.title: Multiple sites
multi_site.subtitle: Nuvemshop, WooCommerce, custom storefronts and product pages with public data.
multi_site.config_desc: Paste up to 20 URLs. For storefronts, the limit defines how many products to fetch per source.
multi_site.inventory_hint: Recommended default for products imported from other storefronts.
multi_site.quantity_hint: Used only when tracking is enabled.
multi_site.ai_media_hint: Use 1 to save AI; other media stays original.
multi_site.ai_batch_hint: Applies to all neutralized images in this batch.

stores.title: Stores
stores.description: Connect and configure your Shopify stores
stores.tutorial_toggle: How to create and install the app on Shopify (step by step)
stores.no_materials: No materials registered for this store yet.
stores.no_stores_body: Import products and publish with AI
stores.additional_logos_hint: Upload alternative logo versions to use on different images.
stores.niche_placeholder: e.g. Women's fitness, Pets, Technology, Home & Decor
stores.niche_hint: Sets the context for all AI: product optimization, policies, SEO
stores.store_description_hint: The more context, the better the AI generates texts and descriptions
stores.language_hint: Optimized products, descriptions, SEO, policies, pages and menus will be generated in this language for this store.
stores.auto_convert_hint: When enabled, imported products already arrive with the store currency and markup applied.

reviews.title: Reviews Generator
reviews.subtitle: Generate synthetic UGC text and images for mockups, creatives and previews. Content comes out in the store's configured language with an AI disclosure.
reviews.disclaimer: Use as synthetic content or demonstration material. Do not publish as a real customer review without disclosing it was generated by AI.
reviews.config_desc: Choose a store, check real products and generate reviews in bulk.
reviews.linked_product_desc: The review will be generated using real Shopify data and exported with the product ID and title.
reviews.select_product_placeholder: Select a real product from the store
reviews.bulk_selection_desc: Use when you want to generate reviews for multiple products at the same time.
reviews.search_placeholder: Search by title, handle, SKU or tag
reviews.no_products: No products found in this store.
reviews.manual_product_desc: Use only for standalone mockups. For linked reviews, select a real product above.
reviews.generate_photos_desc: Creates synthetic UGC-style images, preferring hands, table, unboxing or faceless crops.
reviews.save_widget_label: Save to appear on product page
reviews.save_widget_desc: Links reviews to the selected product and lets the storefront widget load automatically. Manual product is not published.
reviews.widget_desc: Paste this script into the store theme once. Then, saved reviews appear on the corresponding product.

imageNeutralize.queueDesc: 1 image/product, swapped gradually (~US$ {cost} each). Can take a while and sometimes fails on large stores.
imageNeutralize.noneDesc: Links everything to the original image and only neutralizes the text. Recreate the images later with a Shopify app.
imageNeutralize.estimate: Estimate: {count, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} (1 per image) — you have {balance, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} available.
imageNeutralize.estimateLowBalance: Not enough credits: this needs {count} credits and you have {balance}. Top up before continuing.
imageNeutralize.estimateUnlimited: Credit billing isn't enforced yet — this is free for now.

swapImages.description: Recreates each product's image without branding, in the background. ~US$ {cost} per image.

clone_page.desc_overview: Choose an independent resource: clone products, export catalog or configure the Showcase store.
clone_page.desc_shopify: Import products from a public storefront and apply them to a connected store.
clone_page.desc_export: Generate JSON or CSV from a public Shopify source for review and backup.
clone_page.desc_routed: Route orders from the storefront to the dark store checkout with SKU and variant maps.
clone_page.service_clone_desc: Import products from a public storefront via /products.json, preview and apply to a connected store.
clone_page.service_export_desc: Generate JSON or CSV files from the given source for backup, spreadsheet review or manual import.
clone_page.service_showcase_desc: Make a storefront sell while the final checkout is set up in the dark store with mapped variants.
clone_page.import_individual_desc: Paste the URL of a Shopify product, configure and publish just that item.
clone_page.import_bulk_desc: Read the store, select multiple products and import in batches with progress.
clone_page.wizard_desc: Follow the steps: source, selection, options and import.

products_page.title: Products
products_page.subtitle: Import products from any site, optimize with AI and publish to Shopify
products_page.publish_storefront_label: Automatically add to store (Online Store channel)
products_page.publish_storefront_hint: Checked: publishes as active and visible on storefront. Unchecked: saves as draft.
products_page.inventory_hint: With Inventory not tracked, Shopify does not receive a quantity and the product is not born with stock 0.
products_page.auto_logo_hint: If the store has a configured logo, all media goes to the preview already branded.
